reviewedScope.notes: At both viewport widths the violet point and at least one directional arrow are identifiable in each profile. The frontal view shows all three tips and the unobstructed marker at the measured endpoint. The side projection merges aligned arrows. At maximum in the fixed projection the fully drawn violet marker sits visually in front of the plate edge, and remains distinguishable in color and outline.
